name: LauncherResId
meaning: Win32 resource ids used by the launcher, read from SheepD3D.exe's .rsrc (language 1036). Dialog templates are RT_DIALOG and the rest are RT_BITMAP, 8-bit.

name: IDD_OPTIONS_DEBUG
meaning: Unreferenced twin of 0x66, 412x298 DLU, with the 'Loading (Debug)' group visible and enabled.

name: IDD_OPTIONS
meaning: Options dialog (Launcher_OptionsDlgProc); debug group hidden+disabled; no WS_VISIBLE.
